name: unit311-central-mobile
description: Capacitor shell for Unit311 Central (workspace login on unit311central.com)

scripts.build:android: cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android-manifest.mjs && cd android && node -e "require('child_process').execSync(process.platform==='win32'?'gradlew.bat assembleDebug':'./gradlew assembleDebug',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})"
